verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (360 touches) vs 40% at placebo levels (-4 pts, p=0.1203).
Magnet beta: fix -0.0006 (t=-0.05) vs placebo 0.002 (t=0.2). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
